card.name: Scattered label words before key phrases
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires weakly on varied label words such as 'Stability' after 'Storage and', 'be' in 'should be discontinued', and 'utable' in 'not substitutable'.

modes.label: Partway through 'substitutable'
modes.description: Fires on the ending of 'substitutable' in statements that one formulation is not interchangeable with another.
modes.example: RINVOQ LQ oral solution is not substit<<utable>> with RINVOQ extended-release tablets

modes.label: Linking words in instructions
modes.description: Fires on small words like 'be' or 'not' inside statements about stopping a drug or what has not been established.
modes.example: Dasatinib tablets should<< be>> permanently discontinued.

card.plain: It has no clear single meaning and fires on assorted words in drug label text.
